info.title: Chase Sets Headless Marketplace API
info.summary: REST API surface for marketplace-web account commerce experiences.
info.description: Read-after-write API requests use Chase-Sets-Read-After-Write and Chase-Sets-Read-Target-Context headers after browser routes translate the afterWrite query receipt. Browser routes may also carry postWriteHandoff as query metadata paired with afterWrite; it is not a header and is valid only while the paired afterWrite receipt is fresh.

ReadAfterWrite.name: Chase-Sets-Read-After-Write
ReadAfterWrite.description: Short-lived source-context commit receipt from a previous write. When present on a read-model-backed GET or HEAD request, the API waits for the declared projection dependencies before serving the read model.

BrowserAfterWrite.name: afterWrite
BrowserAfterWrite.description: Browser-route query token encoded from a write response commit receipt. Server-side route clients translate this value to Chase-Sets-Read-After-Write for read-model-backed API fetches.

PostWriteHandoff.name: postWriteHandoff
PostWriteHandoff.description: Optional URL-encoded semantic handoff metadata paired with afterWrite on browser routes. Use only to let a destination distinguish a stale 200 empty, stale resource, or 404 from the expected visible outcome of a successful command; do not send it as a header.

ReadTargetContext.name: Chase-Sets-Read-Target-Context
ReadTargetContext.description: Bounded context that owns the target read model on shared API mounts. Server-side clients set this with the request forwarding helpers so exact read freshness routes can be selected.

Consistency.description: Consistency mode for a write response. Event-sourced commands that committed events return eventual.

CommitPosition.description: Highest global event position committed by the write response, when committed events were recorded.

CommitReceipt.description: Encoded source-context commit receipt that clients can forward as Chase-Sets-Read-After-Write on the next read-model-backed request.

currentQuote.description: Current marketplace sales fee quote returned with fee_quote_stale responses.

kind.description: Stable structural handoff kind such as checkout.cart.add-line. Must not contain customer or resource identifiers.

surface.description: Optional stable route or surface label such as account-cart.

PostWriteHandoff.description: Safe semantic browser-route metadata carried as the postWriteHandoff query parameter beside afterWrite. It is not an API header and does not alter projection freshness dependencies.

basis_amount.description: Seller-entered listing or offer unit price.

marketplace_sales_fee_unit_amount.description: Per-unit marketplace sales fee rounded up for positive fractional cents.

seller_net_unit_amount.description: Per-unit seller net after marketplace sales fee.

clientSecret.description: Short-lived provider Account Session client secret for embedded payout setup UI. Clients must not log or persist this value.

components.description: Provider-neutral embedded session components enabled for this client secret.

PayoutEmbeddedSession.description: Embedded payout setup or account management session. Client secrets are returned only to the authenticated caller and must not be stored.

FeeQuoteStale.description: Confirmed fee quote is missing or stale. Response includes error.currentQuote.

ProjectionFreshnessTimeout.description: The fresh-write receipt is valid, but the required projection checkpoints did not catch up before the bounded read consistency timeout. Retry with the same receipt while it remains fresh or show a temporary recovery state.
